## Summary

InterviewOS v3.2.0 introduces the brand-new 3D metallic gold app icon suite across all platforms and fixes reactive document synchronization between the Knowledge Bank, interview workspaces, and the Attach modal.

## What's New

- **New 3D Gold App Icon Suite:** Hand-crafted, pixel-perfect 3D metallic gold squircle emblem with textured charcoal face, chamfered rim, and transparent corner anti-aliasing. Built natively for macOS (`.icns` with full Retina @2x scaling), Windows (`.ico`), Linux PNGs (16×16 to 1024×1024), in-app frontend components, and the web app.
- **Automated Icon Generation Pipeline:** Added `npm run icons:generate` (`scripts/generate-app-icons.mjs`) to automate high-resolution asset generation and packaging.

## Improvements & Fixes

- **Knowledge Bank & Workspace Reactive Sync:** Fixed renderer state staleness where uploaded Knowledge Bank documents were not immediately visible when opening an interview workspace or the "Attach from Knowledge Bank" modal.
- **Cross-Window IPC Event Bus:** Added `interview-docs:changed` IPC broadcast ensuring document additions, removals, and metadata changes propagate reactively across all windows and components.
- **Attach Modal UX Enhancements:** Added an active loading spinner when retrieving fresh documents, and a clear list of already-attached document badges when all Knowledge Bank files are in the active interview context.
- **Verification:** 100% unit tests passing (10/10), 0 React Doctor errors, 0 TypeScript errors.
